critical_code_review_comments: MARKTPHASEN-FILTER block (incl. sat-regime-filter) is only rendered when cfg.mode === 'live' (line 243 in StrategyAutoTradeModal.js). In LIVE-mode this is fine but users who currently have mode='paper' or 'off' cannot preview / pre-configure the new Regime-Quelle selector without first flipping to LIVE. Consider showing this block for paper/off too (read-only) so users can prepare Lab-gating before going live.

First 502 hit on backend right after container spin-up (~3 min boot as documented) – tests recovered on retry. Consider a lightweight readiness probe endpoint or docs note in test_reports so future testing agents wait upfront instead of hitting the slow /releases path first.

regime-release-shadow/active buttons expose the missing-evidence count in their label text ('… (3 fehlt)'). That value comes from the release-check hook, which currently fires on row click; if the check request fails silently the label still shows the previous count. Consider a defensive fallback (e.g. hide the counter suffix on error).
